_comment: Phase 3.5 declarations: every chronic red on main must have an owner + an expiry. The chronic-red gate reads this; a red matched here (and not expired) is DECLARED and the gate does not open an issue for it. A red NOT matched here is ORPHAN and the gate opens/re-pings a deduped issue. The blocking tooth (promote to required after expiry) is a DECLARED admin escalation, never fabricated by the gate.
